outcome: Experiment and promotion events preserve the exact artifacts they revalidate as immutable atom-run-owned snapshots, so caller-owned inputs can disappear without breaking state while snapshot tampering still fails closed.
practical_value: A completed or resumable atom remains readable and trustworthy without keeping every temporary producer directory alive.
stopping_condition: Both real CLI cases survive removal of admitted external sources, every recorded authority is inside the atom run, unrelated source files are not imported, and changing a run-owned snapshot is refused.

captured_cases.expected_outcome: Experiment state resumes from a minimal run-owned import after its source directory is removed, and tampered imported bytes are refused.
Promotion state resumes from minimal run-owned receipt, evidence, surface, and review imports, while tampered imported bytes are refused.
